#### 1. intellectual disability, autosomal recessive 13  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.434)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-204005)

**Proposed mechanism:** TRAPPC9 (HGNC:24473) —DISRUPTS→ TRAPPII complex function (GO:0000346); TRAPPII complex function (GO:0000346) —LEADS_TO→ Unfolded Protein Response (GO:0006986); Unfolded Protein Response (GO:0006986) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual Disability (HP:0001249); Unfolded Protein Response (GO:0006986) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital disorder of glycosylation (HP:0030675). Loss-of-function mutations in TRAPPC9 disrupt the TRAPPII complex, leading to a dysfunctional Unfolded Protein Response, which in turn results in intellectual disability and congenital disorders of glycosylation.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of individuals with homozygous loss-of-function variants in TRAPPC9 who do not exhibit intellectual disability or features of congenital disorders of glycosylation. _(variant: rs747731057)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the role of TRAPPC9 and the TRAPPII complex in the Unfolded Protein Response could reveal therapeutic targets for intellectual disability and glycosylation disorders.

#### 2. neurodevelopmental disorder with epilepsy, spasticity, and brain atrophy  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.391)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-204005)

**Proposed mechanism:** TRAPPC4 (HGNC:24171) —DISRUPTS→ TRAPPII complex function (GO:0005794); TRAPPII complex function (GO:0005794) —DISRUPTS→ ER-Golgi transport (GO:0006888); ER-Golgi transport (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); ER-Golgi transport (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Epilepsy (HP:0001250); ER-Golgi transport (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Brain atrophy (HP:0002066). Loss-of-function mutations in TRAPPC4 disrupt the function of the TRAPPII complex, which in turn impairs ER-Golgi transport. This disruption in protein and lipid trafficking leads to developmental delay, epilepsy, and brain atrophy.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of individuals with pathogenic loss-of-function variants in TRAPPC4 who do not exhibit any neurological phenotypes, or demonstration that TRAPPC4 variants causing disease A do not impact ER-Golgi transport. _(variant: Exome sequencing data from gnomAD showing a high frequency (e.g., >0.1%) of predicted loss-of-function variants in TRAPPC4 in the general population.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the role of TRAPPC4 and ER-Golgi transport in these rare neurological disorders could reveal therapeutic targets for enhancing protein trafficking or mitigating downstream cellular dysfunction, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.

**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-204005)

**Proposed mechanism:** MCFD2 (HGNC:29802) —DISRUPTS→ TRAPP complex (GO:0005802); TRAPPC2L (HGNC:28596) —DISRUPTS→ TRAPP complex (GO:0005802); TRAPP complex (GO:0005802) —DISRUPTS→ protein trafficking (GO:0007010); protein trafficking (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ MONDO:0013331 phenotype (MONDO:0013331); protein trafficking (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Encephalopathy, progressive, early-onset, with episodic rhabdomyolysis phenotype (MONDO:0032681). Impaired protein trafficking leads to the distinct phenotypes of MONDO:0013331 and encephalopathy, progressive, early-onset, with episodic rhabdomyolysis.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that mutations in MCFD2 or TRAPPC2L do not impair the TRAPP complex or protein trafficking, or that these genes are not expressed in relevant tissues affected by the diseases. _(variant: High frequency of pathogenic variants in MCFD2 or TRAPPC2L in the general population (gnomAD))_

This disruption leads to impaired protein quality control and potentially glycosylation defects, ultimately manifesting as intellectual disability in both MONDO:0013331 and intellectual disability, autosomal recessive 52 (MONDO:0014815).

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of pathogenic variants in MCFD2 or LMAN2L in individuals with intellectual disability phenotypes that are demonstrably unrelated to ERAD pathway dysfunction, or the identification of distinct molecular mechanisms for each disease that do not converge on ERAD. _(variant: High-frequency pathogenic variants in MCFD2 or LMAN2L in the general population (gnomAD).)_
